entities.summary: Khalid Hamid is a field hockey player from Pakistan. He was born in Gujranwala. He won a gold medal at the 1984 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles. He joined the Pakistan National Hockey team in 1980. He played India vs Pakistan test series in 1981, Puma Trophy 1981 in Frankfurt, Peugeot Trophy 1981 in Amsterdam, 2nd Junior World Cup 1982 at Kuala Lumpur, King Azlan Shah trophy 1983 at Kuala Lumpur, Top 10 Nations Hockey tournament in 1983 at Hong Kong, World Champions Trophy Tournament in 1983, 1984 & 1988. Khalid Hamid was a athletes & competitors from Gujranwala (b. 1962-10-18, Gujranwala). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
